# Static Review Report: Hip Rotation Muscle Spatial Field & Verification **Scope of Review**: Read-only bounded architectural and mathematical review of [`scripts/fit-hip-rotation-muscles.mjs`](file:///Users/nuinuri/workspace/anatomy/scripts/fit-hip-rotation-muscles.mjs), [`scripts/verify-hip-rotation-muscles.mjs`](file:///Users/nuinuri/workspace/anatomy/scripts/verify-hip-rotation-muscles.mjs), and [`scripts/lib/surface-frame-field.mjs`](file:///Users/nuinuri/workspace/anatomy/scripts/lib/surface-frame-field.mjs), incorporating summary data from [`.cache/hip-rotation-muscles/report.json`](file:///Users/nuinuri/workspace/anatomy/.cache/hip-rotation-muscles/report.json). --- ## 1. Mathematical & Implementation Audit ### A. Spatial Gaussian Blend & Gradient Derivation ([`surface-frame-field.mjs`](file:///Users/nuinuri/workspace/anatomy/scripts/lib/surface-frame-field.mjs#L7-L44)) The common spatial map computes: $$F(p) = \sum_{k=1}^K w_k(p) M_k p, \quad w_k(p) = \frac{q_k(p)}{\sum_{j=1}^K q_j(p)}$$ with unnormalized Gaussian kernel $q_k(p) = \exp\left(\frac{d_{\min}^2 - d_k(p)^2}{2\epsilon^2}\right)$, where $d_k(p) = \|p - \Pi_{S_k}(p)\|$. * **Derivative Consistency**: $$\nabla q_k(p) = - q_k(p) \frac{p - \Pi_{S_k}(p)}{\epsilon^2}$$ $$\nabla F(p) = \sum_{k=1}^K w_k(p) M_k + \sum_{k=1}^K \left(M_k p - F(p)\right) \otimes \frac{\nabla q_k(p)}{\sum_j q_j(p)}$$ * **Indexing & Three.js Matrix Layout**: * In Three.js, `Matrix4.elements` is column-major ($M_{ij} \to \text{elements}[j \cdot 4 + i]$). * Line 41 correctly indexes `m[j*4+i]` for row $i$, column $j$. * `Matrix3.set(...jacobian)` takes row-major entries; since `jacobian` is accumulated in row-major order (`jacobian[i*3+j]`), the construction and determinant computation in Three.js are mathematically sound. * **Scalar Replay & Finite Differences** ([`verify-hip-rotation-muscles.mjs`](file:///Users/nuinuri/workspace/anatomy/scripts/verify-hip-rotation-muscles.mjs#L15-L42)): * Determinant calculation via scalar triple product $\det(J) = J_0 \cdot (J_1 \times J_2)$ matches `Three.Matrix3.determinant()`. * Central finite differences with step $h = 10^{-7}\,\text{m}$ confirm analytical Jacobian residuals $< 10^{-3}$. --- ## 2. Theoretical Limitations & Injectivity Guarantees * **Local Orientation vs. Global Injectivity**: * Vertices ($652{,}173$) and triangle centroids ($1{,}304{,}042$) exhibit strictly positive Jacobians ($J \ge 0.2704$ for $20\,\text{mm}$; $J \ge 0.8090$ for $40\,\text{mm}$). * **Critical Boundary**: A finite set of sampled positive Jacobians proves local orientation preservation at sample points, but **does not** constitute a proof of global injectivity or diffeomorphism. Non-local fold-overs, sub-triangle self-intersections, or transitions near the medial axis of the anchor surfaces remain possible unless explicitly constrained. * **Surface Distance Non-Smoothness**: * The projection $\Pi_{S_k}(p)$ to a piecewise-triangular mesh is non-differentiable across Voronoi cell boundaries of triangle features (cut loci/ridges). The smooth gradient formula holds almost everywhere, but higher-order continuity is $C^0$/piecewise $C^1$. --- ## 3. Source-Frame Composition & Anchor Selection ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph Source["Source Space (Composed Root)"] RawMuscles["76 Raw Muscles"] --> RootXform["Root Transform (Scale ~0.9951 + Denver + BoneHub)"] RootXform --> CommonMap["Common Surface Frame Field F(p)"] end subgraph Frames["Anchor Frame Distance Blends"] RootFrame["Root Frame (Identity)
6 Anchors: Left/Right Pelvis, L2-L5"] LeftFrame["Left Cartilage Pivot Frame (Proper Rotation)
3 Anchors: Left Femur, Tibia, Fibula"] RightFrame["Right Cartilage Pivot Frame (Proper Rotation)
3 Anchors: Right Femur, Tibia, Fibula"] end RootFrame --> CommonMap LeftFrame --> CommonMap RightFrame --> CommonMap CommonMap --> PlacedMuscles["Transformed Muscle Candidates (Candidate-Only)"] ``` * **Frame Composition**: * **Root Frame**: Identity transform over composed source space (including non-unit similarity scale $s \approx 0.9951$ and approximate BoneHub-to-Denver L2–L5 registration). * **Leg Frames**: Two cartilage-pivot proper rotations around bilateral femur head centers (`left` and `right`). * **Anchors (12 bones)**: * Root: `left-Pelvis`, `right-Pelvis`, `VERTEBRA_L2`, `VERTEBRA_L3`, `VERTEBRA_L4`, `VERTEBRA_L5`. * Left: `left-Femur`, `left-Tibia`, `left-Fibula`. * Right: `right-Femur`, `right-Tibia`, `right-Fibula`. * **Explicit Exclusions (4 diagnostic bones)**: * `left-Patella` & `right-Patella`: Excluded as floating extensor elements. * `VERTEBRA_L1`: Excluded due to thoracolumbar junction variance. * `VERTEBRA_L6`: Excluded due to lumbosacral transitional anatomy. * **Blending Leakage**: * Because Gaussian blending has infinite support, own-frame transforms are not strictly satisfied on anchor surfaces: * Left Femur own-frame difference RMS: $5.20\,\text{mm}$ (maximum $26.15\,\text{mm}$ near proximal neck). * L5 Vertebra own-frame difference RMS: $0.021\,\text{mm}$ (maximum $0.074\,\text{mm}$). --- ## 4. Empirical Evaluation from [`.cache/hip-rotation-muscles/report.json`](file:///Users/nuinuri/workspace/anatomy/.cache/hip-rotation-muscles/report.json) | Metric | Legacy (Pre-Fit) | Candidate: 20mm Gaussian | Candidate: 40mm Gaussian | Note / Interpretation | | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :--- | | **Meshes Mapped** | 76 | 76 | 76 | Uniform spatial map; all 76 muscles treated identically | | **Min. Vertex Jacobian** | N/A | `0.2704` | `0.8090` | Strict local positivity across 652k vertices | | **Min. Centroid Jacobian** | N/A | `0.2706` | `0.8091` | Strict local positivity across 1.304M triangles | | **Source Internal Crossings** | 33 | **33 (0 new / 0 removed)** | **33 (0 new / 0 removed)** | **Perfect source-topological preservation** | | **Source Bone Crossings** | 23 | **23 (0 new / 0 removed)** | **23 (0 new / 0 removed)** | **Perfect source-topological preservation** | | **Collisions vs. Fixed HRA** | 211 | 209 (106 new) | 211 (108 new) | Frozen HRA target anatomy induces new collisions | | **Total Skin Outside Vertices**| 17,567 | **6,249** | 18,707 | 20mm significantly reduces total outside vertices | | **New Outside Vertices** | 0 | 3,168 | 9,668 | Vertices previously inside skin penetrating surface | | **Worsened Outside Vertices** | 0 | 1,880 | 4,066 | Outside vertices moving further into exterior | --- ## 5. Architectural Findings & Guardrail Verification 1. **Candidate-Only Isolation**: * Output is strictly constrained to `.cache/hip-rotation-muscles/`. * No runtime models or catalog descriptors (`public/models/`, `data/catalog/`) are modified. * Fixed HRA anatomy remains static and untouched. 2. **Topological Preservation vs. Target Penetration**: * The continuous blend preserves all $33$ source internal muscle crossings and all $23$ source-bone crossings without introducing any new internal source self-intersections. * However, because the target HRA skeleton and skin envelope were not deformed by $F$, $106$ new intersection pairs with fixed HRA and $3{,}168$ new skin-penetration vertices arise. 3. **No Independent Clinical Claim**: * The script limits accurately declare that spatial Gaussian blending is an experimental regularization tool and does not validate anatomical insertion paths, fascia planes, or neurovascular trajectories. --- ## 6. Actionable Takeaways * **Mathematical Rigor**: The Jacobian matrix formulation, Three.js matrix conventions, and scalar replay in [`scripts/verify-hip-rotation-muscles.mjs`](file:///Users/nuinuri/workspace/anatomy/scripts/verify-hip-rotation-muscles.mjs) are free of mathematical indexing bugs. * **Kernel Comparison**: The `20mm` kernel preserves source topology while reducing total skin breach by ~64% compared to legacy; the `40mm` kernel over-smoothes near the hip joint, worsening skin breach. * **Release Guard**: Retain candidate status; no runtime export is justified until skin-conforming boundary constraints or collision-aware post-relaxation are applied against fixed HRA surfaces.

corrections: The reasons given for withholding Patella and L1/L6 (extensor elements, thoracolumbar variance, transitional anatomy) are not established by the inspected files. They are numerical holdouts, not clinical diagnoses.
The new-against-legacy totals106/108 include2 source-internal pairs restored from the original33. Actual new fixed-HRA pairs are104/106. Counts209/211 are not exclusively fixed-HRA pairs.
Preserved broad pairwise crossing sets are not perfect topological preservation and do not prove absence of within-mesh self-intersections or subtriangle folding.

New skin-outside vertices are previously not classified outside the2mm boundary band; this includes surface-band or ambiguous classifications, not only previously inside vertices. These are containment classifications, not measured penetration depth.

The stated derivative of q omits the derivative of the common minimum-distance normalization. That term cancels in normalized weights, so the implemented Jacobian remains correct where squared-distance derivatives exist.
The report does not localize the largest left-femur own-frame error to the proximal neck. This location claim is unsupported.
The report does not prove that all observed failures are caused by smoothing near the hip. A separate worst-tibia-point audit investigates opposite-leg influence.

Skin conformity or collision-aware postprocessing is not by itself a sufficient release condition. Source/bone relations, neurovascular course, full-body/sex-specific alignment and relevant application gates remain required.
limits: Structured SUCCESS is a bounded read-only static review, not an independent numerical rerun, anatomical validation or release approval. Raw claims are preserved with corrections rather than accepted solely on tool success.
